item.title: Fitbit Exposed The Lie After A Mother's Murder
item.description: Connie Dabate was a devoted mother of two whose life ended just days before Christmas when her husband claimed a masked intruder had killed her. But data from Connie's Fitbit, combined with other evidence, unraveled his story and exposed a calculated murder plot driven by deception, infidelity, and betrayal.

item.title: The Doctor Who Murdered His Own Wife
item.description: Michele MacNeill died while recovering from cosmetic surgery after her husband, Dr. Martin MacNeill, claimed she had suffered a medical complication. As their daughters began uncovering his lies, investigators revealed a chilling plot involving prescription drugs, a hidden affair, and a murder staged to look like a tragic accident.

item.title: She Vanished Without A Trace On New Year's Day
item.description: Ana Walshe disappeared from her Massachusetts home on New Year's Day 2023 after her husband claimed she had left for a work trip. As investigators uncovered disturbing digital evidence, suspicious purchases, and attempts to conceal the crime, the case ended with Brian Walshe's conviction for her murder—even though Ana's body has never been found.

item.title: Wife's 911 Call Exposed A Chilling Murder Plot
item.description: Lauren Hugelmaier's life was cut short when her husband, Matthew Phelps, called 911 claiming he woke from a dream after taking cold medicine and found her dead. Investigators uncovered evidence that contradicted his explanation, and Phelps later pleaded guilty to first-degree murder, receiving life in prison without parole.

item.title: Her Own Daughter Planned Her Murder For Money
item.description: Sheila von Wiese-Mack spent years trying to help her troubled daughter, Heather Mack, despite repeated violence and police interventions. During what was supposed to be a luxury vacation in Bali, Heather and her boyfriend murdered Sheila, hid her body inside a suitcase, and abandoned it in a taxi in a plot driven by greed and betrayal.

item.title: A Marriage Marked By Greed And Deadly Betrayal
item.description: Lynn Henthorn and Toni Bertolet appeared to have ordinary marriages, but both relationships ended in shocking deaths that raised immediate suspicion. As investigators uncovered financial motives, carefully planned schemes, and disturbing patterns, the truth behind the tragedies revealed a chilling story of betrayal.

item.title: Drunk Driver Killed Him On The Way To Meet His Daughter
item.description: Ricky Sandoval and his pregnant wife Alyssa were driving to the hospital to welcome their third child when a suspected drunk driver ran a red light and caused a devastating crash. Ricky was killed at the scene, while Alyssa survived long enough to deliver their daughter by emergency C-section just hours later.
